field_mapping.description: DEPRECATED (use node_schema instead). Maps each LLM parameter to its destination container field.

node_config.description: For toolkit nodes only (e.g. tavily_client). Static configuration passed to the underlying toolkit node at construction time — API keys, rate limits, shared defaults. Never exposed to the LLM. Only meaningful when node_type is a registered ToolkitNode type.

expose_sub_tools.description: For toolkit nodes only. Controls which sub-tools are exposed to the LLM. 'all' exposes every sub-tool the toolkit declares. An array of sub-tool name strings exposes only those sub-tools. When set, the LLM sees '<alias>__<subtool>' as the tool name — e.g. if the map key / name is 'web', the LLM sees 'web__search' and 'web__fetch'. Not applicable to non-toolkit node types.

context.description: Dynamic values injected at runtime into node_schema 'fixed' values or fixed_config strings via '${context.key}' template syntax. Use this to pass values computed by upstream nodes (e.g. auth tokens, user IDs) into a tool without hardcoding them in the graph.

tavily_client.name: Tavily Client
tavily_client.description: Web search and fetch via Tavily. Toolkit node that exposes two LLM sub-tools: `search` and `fetch`. Primary usage is via an `llm_call`'s `tool_configurations` (the agent sees `<alias>__search` and `<alias>__fetch`). Also invokable as a regular DAG node by providing `__sub_tool` in its inputs.

__sub_tool.description: Which sub-tool handler to run. Injected automatically by DagToolExecutor when used via tool_configurations; must be supplied by the upstream edge when the node is called directly.

output.description: For search: { query, results: [{title, url, snippet, score, content?}], answer?, credits_used }. For fetch: { url, title?, content, content_length, credits_used }.

api_key.description: Tavily API key. Accepts a literal, `${ENV_VAR}`, or a secure-value placeholder.

enable_cache.description: Cache search and fetch results across runs.

max_calls_per_run.description: Hard cap on search + fetch calls per dag_run.

fail_on_limit.description: When true, exceeding the cap crashes the DAG instead of returning a structured error to the LLM.

retry_policy.description: Retry settings for transient (5xx / timeout) upstream errors.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-request timeout for the underlying reqwest client.

search_defaults.description: Default values for the search sub-tool. Each call may override them.

search.description: Search the web for up-to-date information. Returns a ranked list of titles/URLs/snippets (and optionally full content).

fetch.description: Read cleaned text content from a specific URL.

api_explorer.name: API Explorer
api_explorer.description: OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger 2.0 discovery and validated http_request builder. Toolkit node that exposes five LLM sub-tools: load_spec, list_endpoints, search_endpoint, get_endpoint_details, build_http_request. Stateful: caches parsed specs per conversation, evicted on conversation close.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Cached spec lifetime in seconds (default 24 h).

session_idle_ttl_seconds.description: Evict spec caches whose conversation has been idle this long.

max_spec_size_bytes.description: Abort the spec download if the response exceeds this many bytes (10 MiB default).

default_base_url_override.description: Base URL used when the loaded spec's servers[] is empty.

fuzzy_match_threshold.description: Minimum normalized score for search_endpoint matches (0.0 - 1.0). Scores normalize raw nucleo bonuses by haystack length, so short queries against verbose endpoints land low; defaults to 0.1 for good recall. Raise toward 0.5+ only if you see noisy matches.

retry_policy.description: Retry policy for spec download failures.

load_spec.description: Download, parse, and cache an OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.0 spec. Must be called before the other four sub-tools. Git-forge blob URLs are auto-rewritten to raw URLs.

list_endpoints.description: Paginated browse of endpoints in a previously-loaded spec, optionally filtered by tag.

search_endpoint.description: Fuzzy keyword search across path, summary, operation_id, tags, and description. Returns top-N ranked hits.

get_endpoint_details.description: Returns full per-endpoint metadata (parameters, request_body, responses, security). Emits did_you_mean hints when the operation_id is unknown.

build_http_request.description: Construct a JSON body shaped exactly like the http_request node's input. Routes the LLM-supplied params to path / query / header / body and emits ${SECURE:<ref>} placeholders for auth.

params.description: Flat map of parameter values (path, query, header, body fields). Absent or null defaults to {} and the node returns missing_required_params with endpoint-specific hints.

control_flow.name: Control Flow
control_flow.description: Nodes that manage data flow, graph lifecycle, looping, suspension, and subgraph execution.

debug.name: Debug
debug.description: Nodes for testing and debugging: logging, mock data generation.

math.name: Math
math.description: Arithmetic operation nodes. All require numeric inputs via edges.

integration.name: Integration
integration.description: Nodes for external system integration: HTTP APIs and Python scripting.

llm.name: LLM & AI
llm.description: Language model nodes: direct inference, structured extraction, planning, quality review, and synthesis.

orchestration.name: Orchestration
orchestration.description: Multi-agent coordination and task memory management.

web.name: Web
web.description: Toolkit nodes that give LLM agents internet access: search, fetch, API exploration, browser automation.
